sources.robot_behavior: The dexterous hand is extended over the lower/robot side of the table near the central betting lane. It appears to be touching or nudging a chip, not holding a card, and not carrying a chip stack. It is not near rest pose yet. From this frame it looks more like the hand is still in the action area and settling after the attempted push, rather than fully back at idle. The table layout still looks intact, with chips separated and no obvious scattering or damaged state. I do not see a clear stuck or unsafe condition. The action looks safe to continue, and the prior chip push appears to have failed harmlessly rather than causing a physical problem.
sources.scene_stability: Unstable. Compared Image #1 and Image #2. The robot arm has clearly shifted position between the frames, moving from a more extended pose across the table to a more retracted pose on the right, so the action does not look fully settled yet. The chips and cards look mostly in place, but the arm is still not in a near-idle pose, and with the failed chip push context I would not treat this as stable yet.
